clue.text: Part of Denmark, a promontory?

definitions.meaning: the peninsula forming the Danish mainland
a headland is a stretch of ground that sticks out into the sea, read as two words describing it

explanation.surface: A geography question asking whether some Danish region is a headland.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second reading: split the answer into JUT and LAND, land that juts out, which is just what a promontory is.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula is the mainland region of Denmark, and its name also describes a headland jutting into the sea.

clue.text: Trick by manoeuvring one riding up

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to manipulate or manoeuvre cunningly for advantage
a person mounted on a racehorse

explanation.surface: Someone cons another by manoeuvring a rider aloft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'riding up' reads like clothing creeping upward, but 'up' means in the saddle.
explanation.definitionFit: To manoeuvre slyly for position, and the professional rider of racehorses.

clue.text: Half the score with one combination of cards

parts.note: a score is twenty, and half of it is ten
an ace counts as one in cards

explanation.surface: A card player gets half the points with a single combination.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge and whist a tenace is a holding of two high cards in a suit with a gap between, such as ace and queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridge holding of two cards one step apart in rank, like ace and queen, is this card combination.

clue.text: Everything round earthly circle existing in more than one form

definitions.text: existing in more than one form

parts.note: all means everything
O is round in shape
the tropic of Cancer or Capricorn is a circle of latitude round the Earth

explanation.surface: A geography lesson about everything around a circle of latitude existing in several forms.
explanation.walkthrough: Carbon, for example, is described this way because it exists as diamond, graphite and soot.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical term for an element found in different physical forms, as carbon is in diamond and graphite.

clue.text: Extinguish onset of whooping-cough with external medicine!

indicators.note: says the medicine goes on the outside, wrapped round the letter from the cough

parts.note: a dose is a measured amount of medicine

indicators.note: the onset of a word is its beginning, so take its first letter

explanation.surface: Treating the start of a childhood cough with ointment applied to the skin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'external medicine' suggests an ointment, but it puts DOSE round the W from 'onset of whooping-cough'.
explanation.definitionFit: To douse a fire or light is to put it out, and this spelling is also used.

clue.text: Information prepared from computer file

parts.note: information, especially facts and figures, is data
set means prepared or ready, as in all set

explanation.surface: Someone describes facts prepared from a file on a computer.
explanation.definitionFit: A collection of related records stored together for a computer to process is this kind of file.

clue.text: Repeatedly run away from jerboa

parts.note: to desert is to run away from duty
to rat is to run away from or abandon a cause

explanation.surface: A small rodent keeps running away from someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Repeatedly' asks for two different words for the same 'run away'. The jerboa is a small leaping rodent of North African deserts.
explanation.definitionFit: A jerboa is a small jumping rodent of North African deserts, the animal the WWII Desert Rats took as their emblem.

clue.text: Excessively sweet having little time in the lead

indicators.note: puts the letter for time at the front, leading the word for little

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little

explanation.surface: A sickly-sweet competitor briefly ahead in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the lead' sounds like winning a race, but it means T goes in front of WEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Affectedly dainty or quaint to a cloying degree, as a chocolate-box cottage is.

clue.text: Currently offensive?

parts.note: currently means by way of an electric current, and something that gives a jolt is also appalling

explanation.surface: Asking whether something is offensive these days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Currently' seems to mean nowadays, but it means by electric current: an electric jolt.
explanation.definitionFit: Outrageous or appalling, and literally giving an electric jolt.

clue.text: Deter the drunk who was restrained

indicators.note: a drunk word reels about, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: The intoxicated one who was held back is meant to deter others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges DETER and THE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tied up with a rope, as an animal to a post, so held in check.

clue.text: Miraculous place with loch and waterway!

parts.note: Cana in Galilee is where the Gospel says water was turned into wine, the first miracle
L is the map abbreviation for loch or lake

explanation.surface: A travel note pairing some wondrous spot with a Scottish lake and a channel of water.
explanation.walkthrough: Cana is the Biblical village of the wedding where Jesus turned water into wine.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial channel cut for boats or irrigation is a man-made waterway.

clue.text: Exhausted by wet weather

definitions.meaning: drained of energy and colour, tired out
said of a match or event cancelled by rain

explanation.surface: Someone is worn out by a spell of rain.
explanation.definitionFit: Tired and pale is one sense; a fixture called off because rain flooded it is the other.

clue.text: From professor's chair in old building almost complete

parts.note: ex- means former or old, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the word for the building is left just short of complete, its final letter cut off

parts.note: a cathedral is a large church building

explanation.surface: A professor's seat sits in an old building that is nearly finished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost complete' drops the last L of CATHEDRAL, giving CATHEDRA, which is Latin for chair.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means 'from the chair' and describes a pronouncement made with full official authority, as by a pope or professor.

clue.text: Heavenly-sounding detached area

indicators.note: says the word for the heavens is heard aloud, and a word sounding the same is entered

parts.note: the heavens are the sky, so heavenly suggests sky

explanation.surface: Some divine-seeming patch of land stands apart from the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: SKYE is a large island of the Inner Hebrides off western Scotland, and an island is an area detached from the mainland.
explanation.definitionFit: An island is land cut off from the mainland, so it is a piece of territory set apart.

clue.text: Candid with okra coming from mountains in USA

indicators.note: the answer is made from these letters, so it comes from them rearranged

explanation.surface: Frank talk about the vegetable okra, which comes from American mountains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming from' rearranges CANDID and OKRA. The Adirondacks are a mountain range in New York State.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountain range in northeastern New York State, popular for hiking and lakes.

clue.text: In which couples might face each other in the barn?

definitions.text: In which couples might face each other in the barn?

parts.words: In which couples might face each other in the barn?
parts.note: describes a rural social event: partners lined up facing one another at a barn dance

explanation.surface: Wondering about couples confronting each other inside a farm building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'face each other' hints at a quarrel, but it is partners standing opposite in lines for a traditional folk dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional English folk dance done in lines or squares, typically at a rural barn gathering.

clue.text: Casually dine, hours to be fed

indicators.note: done casually, without order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Eating informally for hours in order to be fed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Casually' rearranges DINE and HOURS.
explanation.definitionFit: Supplied with food needed for growth and health.

clue.text: Tom with drink giving sign of approval

parts.note: Tom Thumb is the tiny hero of the English folk tale
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: Tom, glass in hand, gives an approving gesture.
explanation.walkthrough: Tom is a cue for Thumb via Tom Thumb, the tiny man of the English folk tale.
explanation.definitionFit: The hand gesture with the thumb raised signals approval or success.

clue.text: Cruel doctor has a study pronouncedly icy

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart

indicators.note: says that the word icy is turned into the letters that sound like it when said

parts.note: the word icy, spoken, is the two letters I and C

explanation.surface: A harsh doctor studies something that sounds freezing.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, 'icy' is the letters I C ('eye see').
explanation.definitionFit: Named after Draco, the harsh Athenian lawgiver, it means severe or harsh in punishment.

clue.text: Head office right with one form of the arts that's to do with cultivation of plants

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one
culture means the arts and intellectual pursuits collectively

explanation.surface: A head office is somehow linked to the arts and the growing of plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Gardening, the science and art of growing flowers, fruit and vegetables.

clue.text: I go red outside, rather a different colour

indicators.note: says the word for going red sits outside, wrapping round I

parts.note: to blush is to go red in the face

explanation.surface: Someone blushes and their face becomes another shade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rather' hints at the -ish ending: somewhat blue, not red at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhat blue in hue, a colour unlike the red of a blush.

clue.text: Score two love

definitions.meaning: a score is a group of ...
a tennis score of two-love written as figures reads 2-0, i.e. 20

explanation.surface: A tennis score of two games to nil.
explanation.walkthrough: In tennis 'love' means zero, so two love is 2 and 0, read together as 20.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is the old word for twenty, and the figures 2 and 0 put side by side make that number.

clue.text: Mother church's staff

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: The employees of Mother Church.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the church's employees, but a staff here is a ceremonial rod.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremonial rod carried as a symbol of authority, as in Parliament or a procession.

clue.text: Drunk as well as being depressed everywhere

parts.note: high means intoxicated on drink or drugs
and means as well as
low means sad or depressed

explanation.surface: Someone is intoxicated and feeling down all over the place.
explanation.walkthrough: To search high and low is to search all over.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in every possible place, as when hunting for something lost.

clue.text: Meat about to taken into group of women

indicators.note: says the word for about is put inside the word for the meat

parts.note: ham is cured pork, a meat
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Some meat is about to be carried into a gathering of women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as 'soon going to', but 'about' gives letters on its own and 'to' is only a link word; the parse needs no 'be'.
explanation.definitionFit: The wives and concubines of a household in a Muslim palace, the women of the seraglio.

clue.text: It's sparkling coming from California and Virginia

parts.note: CA is the postal abbreviation for California
VA is the postal abbreviation for Virginia

explanation.surface: A fizzy wine imported from two American states.
explanation.walkthrough: Cava is a Spanish sparkling wine, not American at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish fizzy wine made by the traditional method, like champagne.

clue.text: One with few clothes on when only one star is out?

definitions.text: One with few clothes on when only one star is out?

parts.words: One with few clothes on when only one star is out?
parts.note: the single star is our own, shining in daytime, when someone lies scantily dressed to get a tan

explanation.surface: Wondering who strips off at night when just one star is visible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'only one star is out' suggests a nearly dark night sky, but the one star is the sun, out in daytime.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lying outdoors in light clothing to tan is a person basking in sunshine.

clue.text: An untruth included by foreigner

indicators.note: says the word for an untruth is held within the letters of An

parts.note: taken as written, and split open
a lie is an untruth

explanation.surface: A foreigner has taken on board a falsehood.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from another country, not a citizen of the one where they live.

clue.text: Duck or fish in shell

indicators.note: puts the fish inside the shell, with the shell's letters wrapped round it

parts.note: a pod is the shell or husk of peas or beans
char is a fish of the trout family

explanation.surface: A menu choice between duck and fish served in a shell.
explanation.definitionFit: A diving duck of Europe and North America, the male with a chestnut head.

clue.text: What to do when the sun shines, so it is said, Ted

definitions.text: What to do when the sun shines, so it is said
definitions.meaning: the proverb advises seizing a chance while conditions are good
to ted is a farming verb meaning to turn and spread mown grass to dry

explanation.surface: Advice about sunny days is attributed to someone called Ted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ted' looks like a person's name but is a farming verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says to seize the moment; tedding is literally the farm work of drying grass for fodder.
